timeline.summary: Giada touches an enormous empty bottle and it fills with Halo, which Jinnie presents as the Font, Halo made from nothing.
timeline.quote: we have made Halo from nothing .

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kitt boards a third-class train up Cloudponte Bridge, carrying Halo vials in her jacket and a gown in the bag.
timeline.quote: So that was how she found herself on a Cloudponte Bridge train for the first time in her entire sorry life

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kitt reaches Henzie's candy shop and delivers the vials, receiving a ticket back.
timeline.quote: "I have what you want."

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is mortally wounded in the brawl, seeing Erebos's cold approach, until Giada feeds her Halo that heals her.
timeline.quote: It smashed into her ribs as Elspeth had been straining to hoist her sword

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada's Halo mends Elspeth's bones; Elspeth sees Giada's glow.
timeline.quote: Wounds mended.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada transforms into the radiant magic of Halo, blasting Ob Nixilis away and giving Elspeth strength.
timeline.quote: Giada was transformed into the radiant magic of Halo.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights through the horde with her sword and Halo, then orders the mechanical legion to charge.
timeline.quote: Upon hearing the command word, the metal legion defending the keep turned into aggressors

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Della says Halo cannot cure Phyrexianization but can prevent conversion.
timeline.quote: Halo can act as preventative against the conversion, but not a cure.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Converter beasts chase the escaping citizens, and Errant uses Halo paint jars and her sprayer to defeat them.
timeline.quote: Paint sprayed out, swirling with the iridescent rainbows of the Halo with which it was infused.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri recalls a blast of Halo and realizes she is alive but hollow, no longer a Planeswalker.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: The core of her power, her spark, no longer a part of her.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace wakes in his body with a sword through his chest, and plays dead behind an illusion.
timeline.quote: Jace glances down and sees a sword sticking through his chest

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: The archdemons appoint five families, trap the archangels during a victory celebration and convert them into Halo, then vanish.
timeline.quote: The Demon Lords used the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archdemons plot to trap the angels and distribute their essence across the city.
timeline.quote: trap the angels, and let an age of demons begin

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taking advantage of a Phyrexian slumber, the archdemons and the five capture the archangels during a victory celebration, converting their bodies into Halo.
timeline.quote: the five captured the archangels and their hosts during a city-wide celebration of victory

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Demon Lords use the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappear.
timeline.quote: The Demon Lords used the Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "Betrayal of the demons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask obtains Halo through Vivien Reid.
timeline.quote: Urabrask would establish contact with the planeswalker Vivien Reid and would obtain Halo , a substance that harms Phyrexians.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urabrask conspires with Tezzeret against Norn, goes to New Capenna, obtains Halo and tasks Vivien Reid with finding Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Urabrask conspired with Tezzeret

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Urabrask on Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Atraxa is dispatched to lead the invasion of Capenna and cut off Halo.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn dispatched Atraxa as her lieutenant to lead the invasion

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archdemons betray the angels, turning their bodies into Halo, defeat the Phyrexians, and raise five individuals to demonic status over five factions.
timeline.quote: the archdemons proved their nature and captured the angels

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "Betrayal and the creation of Halo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The fragile alliances between the crime families strain toward breaking as halo runs out and the Adversary makes a power grab.
timeline.quote: The fragile alliances that foster peace between the families are being strained to a breaking point as the precious commodity halo seems to be running out

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
